notes: Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (physical). Physical Windows host when hypervisor evidence is absent or clearly negative. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (hyperv_vm). Hyper-V guest when HypervisorPresent and model/manufacturer evidence support it. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (vmware_vm). VMware guest only when model/manufacturer evidence clearly supports VMware. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (virtualbox_vm). VirtualBox guest only when model/manufacturer evidence clearly supports VirtualBox. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (other_vm). Other VM when hypervisor evidence is present but vendor mapping is unclear. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Runtime-observed Windows host topology category (unknown). Topology unknown when WMI evidence is missing, conflicting, or ambiguous. Capacity values are measured at install time.
Safe native Windows lane when nvidia-smi is absent or fails. Display adapters may be present; CPU install must not fail solely because a GPU is visible.
CUDA lane candidate only after successful nvidia-smi with non-empty NVIDIA GPU name and positive VRAM. This is not a model-fit guarantee. Retain per-device GPU evidence.
No supported GPU detected or GPU state unknown at observation time. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.

Win32_VideoController may report an adapter, but AdapterRAM is not verified VRAM and nvidia-smi did not succeed. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.
nvidia-smi verified VRAM strictly under 8 GiB per device. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.
nvidia-smi verified VRAM from 8 GiB up to under 16 GiB. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.
nvidia-smi verified VRAM from 16 GiB up to under 24 GiB. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.
nvidia-smi verified VRAM 24 GiB or more per device. Reporting category only; does not claim model fit or minimum_vram_gb for any model-size record.
